config.label: Canvas instance base URL, e
config.description: Canvas instance base URL, e.g. https://cms.instructure.com

config.label: Canvas login username/email (recommended) — pair with CANVAS_PASSWORD for auto-login
config.description: Canvas login username/email (recommended) — pair with CANVAS_PASSWORD for auto-login. No SSO/2FA.

config.label: Canvas password (recommended) — required iff CANVAS_USERNAME is set
config.description: Canvas password (recommended) — required iff CANVAS_USERNAME is set

config.label: Canvas personal access token (advanced) — most schools have disabled token creation
config.description: Canvas personal access token (advanced) — most schools have disabled token creation

config.label: Canvas OAuth client ID (advanced — for SSO accounts that can't use username/password)
config.description: Canvas OAuth client ID (advanced — for SSO accounts that can't use username/password)

config.label: Canvas OAuth refresh token (advanced) — bootstrap via canvas-parent-mcp-qr-login
config.description: Canvas OAuth refresh token (advanced) — bootstrap via canvas-parent-mcp-qr-login

config.label: Friendly name for the Canvas instance (defaults to the host portion of the base URL)
config.description: Friendly name for the Canvas instance (defaults to the host portion of the base URL)

config.label: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start
config.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

config.label: Absolute path for the session cache file
config.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.canvas-parent-mcp/session.json.
